Category 3 - Chemical Pesticides (Agricu.one: Data requirements for chemical pesticides for agriculture: the master table (3.1) and special cases (3.2–3.16).

pts: 3.1 has the R / NR table for every category: Legal, Chemistry, Bio-efficacy, Toxicology, Packaging
The Checklist wizard turns that table into a tickable list for your exact case
Combinations: 3.4 herbicides, 3.5 others, 3.6 / 3.8 insecticide + fungicide, 3.11 / 3.12 three a.i.
Seed treatment 3.7–3.9 · Post-harvest (Ethephon) 3.2 · Spray oil 3.3 · MUP 3.15

3.1 Division-wise data requirements 9(3B.one: The master table: which data each division needs (R / NR) for TI, TIM, FI and FIM under 9(3B), 9(3) and 9(4).
nums: real-time storage data due if shelf life was granted on accelerated data
certificate validity when based on accelerated storage data

pts: Form-I, BOD resolution / affidavit, composition affidavit on NJSP, licence, PAN, incorporation, site ownership
Technical must be registered (deemed registration not accepted) before or with the formulation
9(4) TI / FI: embassy-authenticated consent letter and geotagged site photos
Composition and shelf-life claim needed in every category
Sample with CRM and impurities to CIL Faridabad for pre-registration verification
Chemical equivalence: not for the first registration, required after it
Seed treatment: Adhesion to Seed Test always required
9(3) FI / FIM: 2 seasons, at least 3 agro-climatic conditions (R**)
Residues: 1 season, at least 4 locations (R#), with herbicide and soil-applied exceptions
9(4): no bio-efficacy data; claims as per the approved 9(3) product
Benchmarks: fungicide 60-70% control, insecticide 70% reduction, herbicide 70% WCE
9(3) TI / TIM new molecule: all 35 studies
TI new source: items 1-11, 21, 26, 27, 29-34
9(4) TIM: Ames test only · 9(4) TI / FI / FIM: none
Labels, packaging specification, storage performance and transport tests for 9(3B) / 9(3)
9(3B): storage and transport tests needed before commercialisation (R*)

watch: Shelf life on accelerated data: no real-time data within 2½ years and the certificate becomes invalid

3.2 Post-harvest treatment (Ethephon).one: Extra data for pesticides used on harvested produce (fumigants, Ethephon ripening agent), for technical, MUP and formulation.

pts: Fate and behaviour in treated produce, air (gases), water and soil
Also used in the field or household? Then full TIM / TI 9(3) data too
MUP: registration status abroad; full technical data if the technical is not registered
Formulation: technical / MUP must be registered, else submit full technical data too
Chemistry incl. rate of release, shelf life, process, sample for verification
Residue at intervals from 0 hours until BDL, 3 repeated trials
Label claims as per the latest Government Gazette notification

3.3 Petroleum derived spray oil (PDSO).one: Data requirements for petroleum-derived spray oils (mineral oil products) under 9(3B) and 9(3) (326th RC, 2012).

pts: Full chemistry for both: source, composition, identity, specification, ATR, impurities, process
Shelf-life data needed for 9(3) only
Multilocation trials by ICAR / CSIR / SAU: 3 locations for 9(3), 2 for 9(3B), two seasons
Residues, parasites and predators, compatibility, foreign tolerance limits
Acute studies, birds, fish, bees, medical data: both categories
Neurotoxicity, teratogenicity, reproduction, carcinogenicity, metabolism, mutagenicity: 9(3) only

3.4 Combination of two registered herbic.one: Data for a combination product of two herbicides that are each already registered (291st RC, 2008).

pts: Composition, identity, properties, specification, method, ATR, shelf life, process
Bio-effectiveness and phytotoxicity always
Persistence and residues only if either a.i. is higher than already registered combinations
Six acute studies, birds, fish, bees, earthworm, medical data, worker health records
Unregistered component: full technical data for that component

3.5 Combination pesticides (not herbicid.one: Data for indigenous manufacture of combination products other than herbicides (211th RC, revised 296th RC).

pts: Source, composition, identity, specification, ATR, shelf-life claim and data, process
Sample with standards for chemical verification
Two seasons, at least 3 agro-climatic conditions; cost-benefit ratio
Higher a.i. than registered formulations: persistence and residue data too
Fungicides: no parasite / predator data
Each technical must be registered u/s 9(3), else full data for it

3.6 Insecticide + Fungicide combination.one: Data for a foliar-spray combination of one registered insecticide and one registered fungicide (284th RC, 2007).

pts: Composition, identity, properties, specification, method, ATR, shelf life, process
Insecticide alone, fungicide alone and the combination, against label pests and diseases
Persistence and residues if a.i. is higher than already registered
Six acute studies, birds, fish, bees, earthworm, medical data, worker health records

3.7 New formulation for seed treatment 9.one: Data for a new seed-treatment formulation (296th RC, 2008).

pts: Source, composition, properties, specification, ATR, shelf life, process
Sample with reference standard; residue method in BIS format
Against label pests and diseases across agro-climatic zones
Fungicides: no parasite data, but data on beneficial soil flora and fauna
Mixing with other seed dressings or bio-fertilisers: compatibility data
Six acute studies, birds, fish, bees, earthworm, medical data, worker health records

3.8 Insecticide + Fungicide combination.one: Data for a seed-treatment combination of one registered insecticide and one registered fungicide (296th RC, 2008).

pts: Each component alone and in combination, two seasons
Persistence and residues only if a.i. is higher than registered formulations
Six acute studies, birds, fish, bees, earthworm, medical data, worker health records
